result.summary: Applied 3 edits to lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex per the design doc's §2, with one correction found during implementation (recorded in the design doc's §2a and this summary, not silently applied without a trail): dispatch_start/4 (line 212) required BOTH `%InstanceState{} = instance_state` AND `%Token{} = token` -- applying only `%Token{} = token` (the design's original spec) fixed the originally-reported Token warning but surfaced a 4th, previously-unreported InstanceState warning on the same function's line 220 once the compile gate was re-run (Elixir 1.20's type checker apparently did not report both issues in the same function body in one pass). dispatch_end/3 (line 230) got `%InstanceState{} = instance_state` per the design, unchanged from spec. dispatch_human_task/3 (line 244) got `%InstanceState{} = instance_state` per the design, unchanged from spec. Verified: `rm -rf _build/dev/lib/letflow && mix compile --warnings-as-errors` now exits 0 (`echo $?` = 0) with output 'Compiling 66 files (.ex)' / 'Generated letflow app' and zero warning blocks -- quoted directly, not assumed. Full suite re-run after the fix: `mix test` -> 'Finished in 93.6 seconds (2.2s async, 91.3s sync)' / 'Result: 761 passed (5 properties, 756 tests)' -- no failures line present, 761/761 green, same test count as before this change (this fix adds no test, removes no test). No function body logic touched -- diff is exactly 3 lines, each a parameter-list addition only (confirmed via `git diff lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex`, 3 lines changed, 0 added/removed elsewhere).
